# Ben Viwatmanitsakul

> Portfolio of Ben Viwatmanitsakul, a design engineer and frontend architect in Lone Tree, Colorado. The site is built with Edge, his design system, which publishes its own machine-readable rules.

## Edge design system

- [Edge for agents](edge/llms.txt): tokens, contrast data and component rules for building UI with Edge
- [Rules index](edge/rules/index.json): every component's rules file, as data
- MCP server: install `@bensumet/edge` from GitHub Packages and run `npx edge-mcp`, with tools `get_tokens`, `get_component_guidance` and `check_contrast`
- [Source](https://github.com/bensumet/edge-design-system): Edge's package, with its rules, tests and changelog

## Sections

- [Work](https://bensumet.github.io/#/work): case studies for CoreConnect and P&C Immersive AI
- [Designing with AI](https://bensumet.github.io/#/ai): working prototypes and measured design decisions
- [System](https://bensumet.github.io/#/system): Edge's foundations, components, states, AI patterns, a console demo, the agent layer and evaluations
- [Craft](https://bensumet.github.io/#/craft): book design, type, logos, wall art, paintings
- [About](https://bensumet.github.io/#/about)
